Single-molecule localization microscopy confirmed the mitochondrial localization of adenovirus-transduced Fam210a in Cos7 cells and revealed its non-overlapping localization with the outer membrane marker TOM20 (Fig. 2g). A protease protection assay further revealed that FAM210A is a trans-inner membrane protein with the N-terminus in the mitochondrial intermembrane space and a ~12-kDa C-terminus in the mitochondrial matrix (Fig. 2h). This C-terminus was protected from protease digestion after swelling (Fig. 2h).
